Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing multiple daily drawing on-line games.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to multiple daily drawing online games; and addingnew sections to chapter 67.70 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 67.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Pursuant to RCW 67.70.040(1)(f), the commission may offer online games in which the drawing or selection of winning tickets occursmore than once every twentyfour hours. (2) The multiple daily draw account is created as a separateaccount outside the state treasury. The account is managed,maintained, and controlled by the commission and consists of allrevenues received from the sale of lottery tickets for online games inwhich the drawing or selection of winners occurs more than once everytwentyfour hours, and all other moneys credited or transferred to itfrom any other fund or source under law. The account is allottedaccording to chapter 43.88 RCW.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 67.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The net revenues, if any, in the multiple daily draw account shallbe deposited in the general fund.
